tools.name: list_skills
tools.title: List skills
tools.description: Every skill this repo is bound to, with its description.

tools.name: search_skills
tools.title: Search skills
tools.description: Skills whose name, description or text match any word of query, best first, with where each matched.

tools.name: get_skill
tools.title: Get a skill
tools.description: A skill's SKILL.md and the paths of its other files; with path, that one file instead. To run a script, get it and run your copy.

path.description: One file of the skill, e.g. scripts/check.sh. Omit for SKILL.md and the file list.

version.description: An earlier version; omit for the latest.

tools.name: submit_feedback
tools.title: Submit feedback on a skill
tools.description: If you edited something a skill mentions, or a skill gave you wrong information, report it before you finish, quoting the skill's text and showing the evidence. quote is that text exactly, evidence what shows it is wrong, and what_changed what you did instead or changed. A report missing any of these, or quoting text the skill does not have, is refused with how to fix it; resubmit it fixed. Include files to suggest exact text. Under a name no skill has yet, it asks for that skill: say what it is for in feedback, follow honed/skill-writing and draft its SKILL.md; no quote is needed. Skills are revised from these reports.

name.description: The skill, e.g. team/code-review: an optional prefix for its group, then lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.

quote.description: The exact text in the skill that is wrong or that your edit made out of date, copied from get_skill: a whole sentence or line. Not needed for a new skill.

evidence.description: What shows the quote is wrong: each a file with its current contents, or a command with what it printed. Not needed for a new skill.

path.description: A file that shows the quote is wrong, e.g. src/api.ts.

content.description: That file's current contents, or the part that shows it.

command.description: A command you ran, e.g. npm run lint.

what_changed.description: What you did instead of what the quote says, or what you changed that it describes. Not needed for a new skill.

feedback.description: Anything else worth knowing. For a new skill: what it is for.

files.description: Optional: files you suggest, each with its whole content.

author.description: Your role or task, e.g. reviewer on PR 12.
